messages:
maria.lopez: heads up — noticed a perf regression on Mistral-8x7B after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. tail latency spikes on sliding-window traces with long conversations.
jonathan: :eyes: can you paste a repro or perf profile? what sequence lengths / batch sizes?
sam_kaplan: saw similar in canary. median p95 went from ~85ms -> 210ms for seq=1024, batch=4 on A100.
maria.lopez: attaching quick run: model=mistral-8x7b, kernel_selector=v2, rope_scale=1.0, kv_prefetch=on, sliding_window=512. Profiling shows heavy kernel fallback to generic attention at later layers.
olivia_r: do we have example logs from runtime? any kernel chooser decisions printed?
maria.lopez: snippet: 
```
[INFO] kernel_selector: chosen=MHA_tiled (layers 0-10)
[INFO] kernel_selector: fallback=GENERIC_ATTENTION (layers 11-19)
[DEBUG] kv_cache: prefetch_hits=12, prefetch_misses=98
[WARN] batching: split_batch for request_id=abc123 due to tile_mismatch
```
jonathan: that prefetch_misses number is suspicious. could be tile boundary + rope-offset wrap causing mask mismatch, forcing fallback.
sam_kaplan: hypothesis: rope_scale interactions with sliding_window cause bogus pos indices for cached KV, so kernel fails seq-bound checks and we go generic. I can reproduce by toggling rope_scale to 0.5 — fallback goes away and p95 drops.
maria.lopez: test commands I used: `./run_inference --model mistral-8x7b --seq 1024 --sliding 512 --batch 4 --rope-scale 1.0 --kv-prefetch on`
jonathan: can we add extra logging in kernel_selector to dump reason for fallback? Maybe show "pos_check_failed" vs "tile_mismatch".
olivia_r: perf-bot pinged with trace id for one of the spikes: trace=tr_2024_11_06_09_12. perf-bot: `Anomalous tail latency detected: p99 874ms (baseline 240ms)`
perf-bot: memory snapshot attached to trace tr_2024_11_06_09_12 (heap stable, no OOM).
sam_kaplan: quick patch idea: relax pos-check for sliding-window when consecutive KV blocks have consistent wrap offsets, then rely on mask enforcement rather than strict equality. might avoid generic fallback.
jonathan: risk is subtle correctness bugs — we need unit tests that simulate pos-wrap and sliding-window cache reuse. add test vectors with rope offsets +-1 and ensure outputs match reference.
maria.lopez: created a small test harness, failing case here: `assert outputs_match(reference, runtime_out) == false` when fallback happens. if we force reuse with adjusted pos normalization, outputs match.
olivia_r: let's schedule a short hotfix: 1) instrument kernel_selector for fallback reason; 2) add unit tests for pos-wrap + sliding-window; 3) run a canary with kv_prefetch toggled off to verify improvement.
jonathan: agree. I'll own logging + unit tests. Sam, can you prototype the pos-normalization tweak and bench?
sam_kaplan: on it. will post results in ~2h.
maria.lopez: thanks team. tagging @perf-bot to re-run nightly perf diff with kernel logs enabled.
perf-bot: scheduled nightly diff run: job=perf-diff-1839001234, notifications will follow. :white_check_mark:
